アイデンティティセキュリティ基盤「Josys」について
Josysは、企業内のあらゆる認証情報（アイデンティティ）を統合的に管理・防御する、AI駆動のアイデンティティセキュリティ基盤です。従業員・業務委託先のアカウントに加え、AIエージェントやサービスアカウントなど、人・AI・システムを横断して増加する認証情報を一元的に可視化し、守ります。
ダークウェブ起点の認証情報漏洩・感染端末の検知、AIエージェントの自動発見と管理、ポリシーにもとづくAIの自律型セキュリティ対応を中核に、SaaS統合管理で培ったアクセスガバナンスやライセンス最適化の機能を統合。権限管理やリスク対応を自動化し、セキュリティ人材不足のなかでも運用負荷を抑えながら、組織全体のアイデンティティを守ります。
Josysは、"すべてのアイデンティティ、すべてのアプリケーションを、AIで守る"ことを通じて、日本企業が安心して事業活動を行える環境づくりを推進してまいります。
解決する課題
急速に利用が拡大するSaaS・AIアプリにより、世界中のコーポレート部門は複雑な管理業務を求められる状況にあります。また、昨今のサイバーセキュリティインシデントでは、漏洩したIDを用いた攻撃がスタンダードとなっており、エンタープライズを中心により高いレベルでの対策が急務となっています。
一方で、求められる速度に管理が追いつかず、管理の抜け・更新漏れ・管理主体の分散など、企業のITガバナンスは危機的な状況にあります。これはコロナ禍を経てSaaS利用が増大した背景があり、日本だけでなくグローバルで同時多発的に発生している新しい課題であり、企業規模に関わらず多くの企業が抱えている経営リスクです。
そこで求められるのは、AIによってアイデンティティ・SaaS・デバイスの情報を統合的に管理し、リスクを最小化しながら運用を効率化することです。ジョーシスはAI Drivenなマネジメントプラットフォームを通じて、現場のオペレーションまで一貫して支援し、企業のアイデンティティ管理におけるガバナンス向上とセキュリティリスクの最小化に寄与します。
日本発グローバル企業への挑戦
海外発SaaSを国内で使う機会は多いものの、グローバルで使われる日本発SaaSはほとんどないのが実情です。それだけ "グローバルプロダクト" を事業として成功させることの難易度は高いとも言えます。JOSYSはそんな現状を打ち破り、日本をマザーマーケットとしながら世界でも使われるサービスを提供していくチャレンジの真っ只中にいます。この難易度の高い課題を、優秀なグローバルの同僚と共に、自分自身の手で創り上げていく熱い想いのある方を募集しています。
概要
Josysは「Simplify IT, Empower communities」をミッションに、企業のIT運用そのものを再定義するグローバルSaaS / AIソリューションを提供しています。 現在、エンタープライズ企業からの引き合いが急速に拡大しており、本ポジションは、お客様の「IT運用の変革」を最前線で支援し、Josysの提供価値を最大化させるAccount Consultantです。
導入支援（Solution Consulting）を通じて強固な信頼基盤を築いた後、お客様の潜在的な課題に対し、SaaS・AI・BPOを組み合わせた統合的なソリューションを能動的に提案します。「顧客の成功＝Josysの利用拡大（Expansion）」と捉え、アップセル・クロスセルを通じてお客様のITインフラを全方位で支えるパートナーとしての活躍を期待しています。
業務内容
エンタープライズ顧客の認証・セキュリティ構造の要件定義と設計
導入初期段階において、お客様の既存のID（アイデンティティ）基盤、セキュリティポリシー、ネットワーク環境をヒアリングし、Josysを中核とした最適な統合管理モデルを設計します。
複雑なアイデンティティ環境のハックと移行ロードマップ策定
従業員・業務委託先だけでなく、AIエージェントやサービスアカウントなど、混在する複雑な権限情報を構造化し、ガバナンスを効かせるための移行プロセスを定義します。
技術的課題の解決とプロダクトへのフィードバック
導入フェーズにおける難易度の高い技術的制約やAPI連携等の課題に対し、自ら技術的な解決策（ソリューション）を提示します。また、現場で得たインフラ・セキュリティニーズを開発チームへフィードバックし、基盤の進化を共創します。
アーキテクチャの標準化・型化
業界別や企業規模別の成功パターンを「リファレンスアーキテクチャ（標準設計モデル）」として言語化・Playbook化し、組織全体の導入スケーラビリティを向上させます。
求める経験
【専門知識は不要です】 現時点でセキュリティ、インフラ、ID管理の知識は一切問いません。入社後に1からキャッチアップできる体制が整っています。「複雑な物事を整理することが好き」「顧客の課題解決に深く伴走したい」という意欲を重視した採用を行っています。

Armis is the leading unified asset visibility and cybersecurity intelligence platform — trusted by Fortune 100 enterprises and governments to protect unmanaged, IoT, OT, and IT environments.

We are expanding our Vulnerability Intelligence, Prioritization & Detection Response (VIPR/VMDR) capability to elevate Armis’ cyber defense posture globally.

Own the end-to-end vulnerability and detection lifecycle — from discovery, triage, and prioritization through remediation and reporting.
Lead the Vulnerability Intelligence, Prioritization & Detection Response (VIPR/VMDR) function, integrating threat intel, exploit data, and asset context to drive data-backed decisions.

Partner with Customer Success, Security Engineering, and Cloud Infrastructure teams to track remediation SLAs, exposure metrics, and MTTR improvements.
Build and publish risk dashboards, customer-facing reports, and executive briefings using Splunk, Power BI, Elastic, or AMS/VIPR.
Develop and maintain the Armis Vulnerability Prioritization Model (VPM) — aligning exploit intelligence, CVSS/EPSS scoring, Armis Proprietary Risk Scoring, and business criticality to guide customer risk posture.
Support penetration test remediation, red team findings, and customer security audits.
Author weekly vulnerability intelligence reports, zero-day summaries, and leadership briefings for APJ/APAC stakeholders.
Collaborate with Product Security and Threat Intelligence teams to integrate vulnerability and detection data into Armis platform insights.
Deliver training sessions and enablement workshops for customers, engineers, and analysts on vulnerability trends, tools, and operational best practices.
6–10+ years of experience in Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence, or Security Detection Engineering.
Deep expertise in CVSS, CWE/CVE, NVD, KEV, and exploit prediction (EPSS) frameworks.
Hands-on experience with vulnerability and detection management platforms (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Wiz, Prisma Cloud, ServiceNow VR, Centrix for VMDR).
Proven ability to develop automation scripts and data pipelines (Python, PowerShell, Bash, REST APIs, JSON).
Familiarity with risk-based vulnerability management (RBVM) and prioritization scoring models.
Strong understanding of cloud-native security, container scanning, and hybrid infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Exceptional data storytelling skills — turning technical findings into actionable executive insights.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Exceptional communication skills across all levels of technical, middle management, and executive leadership personnel.

15+ years of hands-on software development experience building cloud-native, business-critical platforms.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people.

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter.

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

Are you looking to make a real impact and play a meaningful role in the growth of our company?
The Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) multiplies Elastic's technical reach through partners. An account SA wins one deal at a time. You build technical capability across a focused group of partners (SIs, resellers, MSSPs, cloud providers) so they can source pipeline, win deals, and deliver Elastic on their own.
The role has three pillars: drive partner-sourced pipeline; multiply technical capacity and co-build repeatable solutions.
You will work a defined portfolio of managed partners, each with an agreed technical engagement plan, and be measured on outputs, partner sourced deals, committed engagement plans and published assets, not on activity volume but impact.
Prior presales experience in the software sector is required for this role. It is a sales-aligned position that carries a partner-sourced pipeline target and candidates should plan for up to 40% travel.
What you will be doing
Drive growth with and through partners
Generate approved partner deal registrations, jointly owned with Partner Managers for your territory.
Run partner-tailored sales playbooks on registered deals: qualify the deal shape, support intake and technical scoping, and help partners attach their own services, lifting average deal size.
Accelerate partner-led opportunities, hands-on labs and proofs of concept, in collaboration with account AEs and SAs.
Stays current on competitive dynamics and market trends, equipping partners with sharp "Why Elastic" positioning over competing vendors
Architect of leverage
Own the technical relationships and named champions at each partner in your portfolio; build trusted advisor status with senior technical stakeholders.
Create, commit and maintain a Technical Engagement Plan per focus partner, the technical section of the Joint Business Plan, and run quarterly read-outs with the partner, Partner Manager and other stakeholders.
Deliver enablement and certification roadmaps, accreditations & certifications, that move partners up a defined technical maturity model.
Leads hands-on technical lab workshops across Elastic products, building partner technical confidence and solution fluency
Co-innovate on repeatable solutions
Co-architect solution blueprints and reference architectures with partners, including hyperscalers.
Build reusable demos, sales cards and battlecards partners can run without Elastic in the room; co-publish reference win stories and joint blog posts.
Authors customer-facing content including white papers, blogs, and sales collateral, informed by market trends and deep relationships with partner technical leaders
Supports technical deployments of Elastic in partner labs, demonstration environments, and testing grounds

8+ years in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting and/or cloud/infrastructure technologies.
3+ years of pre-sales experience in the software sector, ideally partner-facing: channel, alliances, SI/GSI or MSSP ecosystems.
A one-to-many mindset: you would rather teach ten engineers to run the demo than run it ten times yourself, and you can show where your enablement turned into someone else's win.
Working knowledge of security operations (SIEM, endpoint, cloud security) and/or observability, plus an understanding of AI and semantic search technologies.
Professional experience architecting or operating solutions on AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure.
Commercial fluency: you can read a deal, discuss services scope and margin with a partner, and translate technical capability into the business case their customer buys.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences
Comfort with ambiguity and a self-starter's bias to action; you inspire partner teams to work on what is most relevant, not just what is urgent.
Demonstrated ability to stay focused and deliver results amid ambiguity, distractions, and competing priorities.
Comfortable operating both collaboratively across partner and cross-functional teams and independently to execute a plan and deliver results
Skilled at leading through influence, aligning partners and internal stakeholders around shared priorities and goals
Technical experience and depth in at least one Elastic solution area required (AI agents & Search, security operations, or observability); cross-domain fluency across all three is a differentiator
Must be able to travel primarily across the LATAM region to partner offices, events, and conferences, with occasional travel outside the region; approximately 40% travel expected
Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese across written, verbal, and presentation contexts

Meaningful, demonstratable, experience with AI/ML technologies, including exposure to LLMs, embeddings, vector search, or agentic AI frameworks
Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Bash, or similar) for automation, integration, or demonstration purposes
Prior experience in a technical training, instruction, or curriculum development capacity is a plus

As a Solutions Architect in GitLab's Southern Europe team with particular focus on France, you'll be a trusted advisor to GitLab prospects and customers, helping them understand how GitLab's DevSecOps platform addresses both technical requirements and business objectives across the entire software development lifecycle.

You'll guide organizations through their digital transformation journeys, from planning through monitoring, using your technical expertise, understanding of cloud and modern software development practices, and strong customer empathy.

Reporting to a regional Solutions Architect manager and partnering closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams, you'll own technical evaluations (including proof of value initiatives and workshops), shape solution architectures, and serve as the voice of the customer back to Product Management.

You'll focus on driving successful platform adoption, influencing revenue growth through solution selling, and building long-term, trust-based relationships that showcase GitLab's differentiated position in an AI-driven DevSecOps landscape.

Lead technical discovery, demos, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the full lifecycle.
Drive the technical evaluation process as the directly responsible individual, including solution design, POC/POV ownership, workshop design, and the technical components of tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Southern EU to shape and execute account strategies that support new customer acquisition and expansion.
Build and deepen relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guiding them through GitLab-driven transformation and enabling them to become GitLab advocates.
Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration, continuous deployment, security, and cloud practices, challenging existing approaches to improve return on investment.
Serve as the voice of the customer with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing by sharing feedback, use cases, and competitive insights that inform roadmap and positioning.
Maintain and extend your technical expertise in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and related cloud technologies, creating reusable examples, best practice guidance, and technical collateral for customers and partners.
Invest in your own growth and development through ongoing learning, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to continuously improve the impact of the Solutions Architect team.

4+ years of experience engaging with customers in technical pre-sales, consulting, or similar roles, guiding them through solution design and evaluation.
Proficiency with the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows.
Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, and the ability to map platform capabilities to customer use cases.
Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, with the ability to discuss deployment, security, and operations options with technical teams.
Ability to lead technical evaluations such as proofs of concept or proofs of value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messages for practitioners through to senior business and technical decision makers.
Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, and acting as a customer advocate to internal teams such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
Motivation to continuously develop professionally, including learning new technologies, deepening GitLab platform expertise, and applying transferable experience from related fields.
Remote based role in France, ideally living in Paris region or Lille, speaks excellent French and English

We, the Solutions Architect team, are part of GitLab's Sales organization and serve as the technical counterpart to Account Executives, with this role focused on opportunities across France reporting into a regional Solutions Architect Manager.

Our mission is to help customers realize the full value of GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform by advising on architecture, running technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guiding customers through their digital transformation.

We work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing, collaborating asynchronously across regions to share best practices, create reusable technical collateral, and act as the voice of the customer.

We are focused on helping customers modernize end-to-end software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a rapidly evolving AI and DevSecOps landscape.

It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works.

Results that matter.
Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

You'll play a critical role in supporting our enterprise customers early in their journey to ensure the absolute success of their architectural foundations. You'll will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production-ready ecosystem. You will serve as the trusted technical advisor, leading new customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.
Sitting at the heart of our customer-first culture, you will shape tailored onboarding blueprints, orchestrate complex delivery workstreams, and guarantee a predictable, accelerated time‑to‑value. For self‑managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deliver secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.

Hands-on experience with production workloads in at least one major cloud provider ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
Deep technical proficiency in core networking infrastructure, including VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints.
Hands-on experience and technical proficiency in SQL or NoSQL databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Experience with ETL/CDC platforms and data ingestion.
Proven track record implementing Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) design.
Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container environments).
Hands-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j).
Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk).
Exposure to cloud compliance frameworks (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and data residency deployment patterns.

Drive customer value by translating complex business requirements into tailored technical solutions that solve core business challenges and accelerate cloud adoption.
Lead complex technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to align on success criteria, KPIs, milestones, and mitigation strategies for project risks.
Guide the instantiation of Neo4j AuraDB environments or self-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures utilizing private endpoints and IP allow lists.
Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption-at-rest protocols, and enforce least-privileged access through enterprise SSO and RBAC configurations.
Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise development teams on Neo4j driver optimization, connection pooling, and retry logic.
Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools for logs and metrics, while delivering best-practice workshops on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
Produce high-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and a next-step backlog—to seamlessly transition customers to Professional Services and Cloud Operations teams.
Synthesise field insights and lessons learned to continuously iterate and optimise Neo4j’s global technical onboarding methodology and frameworks.

s.h: What You'll Do as Solution Architect

Act as the trusted architecture counterpart for enterprise architects and technical leadership on the customer side — from first pre-sales conversations through large-scale production deployments.
Design the target solution architecture for enterprise transformations: how Taktile integrates into the customer's existing landscape of core systems, data platforms, and surrounding services, and how that architecture evolves over a multi-year journey.

Estamos buscando um Arquiteto de Soluções para o Time Vetta!

Buscamos um profissional que atuará como principal referência de arquitetura, garantindo aderência ao HLD da solução, aos padrões tecnológicos e de DevSecOps da empresa, e assegurando que as integrações com plataformas de engenharia, BIM/ACC e sistemas corporativos de CapEx sejam robustas, seguras e escaláveis. VOCÊ JÁ CONHECE A VETTA?

Na Vetta, acreditamos que a tecnologia e a inovação são essenciais para criar um futuro mais sustentável e eficiente para todos.

Como uma empresa líder em digitalização industrial, nossas soluções estão ajudando clientes em todo o mundo a reduzir o consumo de energia, a melhorar a eficiência operacional e apoiar a transição energética através da descarbonização.

Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos emocionantes e desafiadores com alguns dos maiores especialistas da indústria . Além disso, você fará parte de uma equipe dedicada em gerar um impacto positivo no mundo e em ajudar nossos clientes a alcançar seus objetivos de negócios.

O Time Vetta sabe a importância do trabalho em equipe e da colaboração para alcançar resultados que atingem todo o globo – ao mesmo tempo que a carreira de cada um é transformada. Se você quer compartilhar a sua perspectiva para um mundo mais sustentável, venha ser parte do Time Vetta! 💙 Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:
Definir, evoluir e validar a arquitetura da solução (back-end e front-end desacoplados, executando em Docker Containers), garantindo aderência ao HLD e aos padrões corporativos.
Especificar e revisar as integrações do Smart CapEx PQ com plataformas de engenharia e BIM (ex.: Autodesk Construction Cloud - ACC), viabilizando a extração e validação automatizada de quantitativos a partir de modelos 3D.
Definir a arquitetura de integração com o sistema corporativo de gestão do CapEx (PPM Ecosys) e demais sistemas internos/externos.
Liderar tecnicamente desenvolvedores back-end (Java/Spring Boot/Hibernate) e front-end (Angular), promovendo boas práticas e qualidade de código.
Definir e manter a infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform em ambiente Microsoft Azure.
Estabelecer e monitorar a esteira de CI/CD, incluindo análise e aprovação de Pull Requests via gitflow, qualidade de código via SonarQube e integração com processos de mudança (ITSM).
Garantir cobertura mínima de 90% de testes unitários e aderência às práticas de DevSecOps.
Apoiar o Product Owner na priorização técnica e na viabilidade das histórias do backlog.
Conduzir a documentação técnica da solução (arquitetura, integrações, decisões e trade-offs) e sessões de transferência de conhecimento para o squad.
Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (planning, daily, review, retrospectiva e refinamento).

Technical Leadership: Guide strategic customers through the full lifecycle of Databricks platform administration—from initial architectural design to production deployment.
Production-Grade Architecture: Architect secure, scalable enterprise deployments that satisfy complex cloud networking, identity, and security compliance standards.
Domain Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert in core areas su ch as major cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), infrastructure-as-code (IaC), networking, or identity management.

5+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role with deep expertise in cloud platform architecture across AWS, Azure, or GCP, including cloud security, networking best practices, and enterprise data platform design
2+ years of professional experience with distributed architectures and big data technologies (e.g., Apache Spark™, Hadoop, Kafka).
2+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role (Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, or Consulting).

Security & Identity: Platform, network, data, and GenAI/model security; encryption; vulnerability management; compliance; and identity protocols (SCIM, OAuth, SAML, Federation).
Networking & Deployments: Enterprise cloud architecture design, network routing, performance optimization, and large-scale deployment management.
Platform Administration: High availability, disaster recovery, cluster orchestration, observability (logging, monitoring, auditing), and cloud cost management.
Infrastructure Automation (InfraOps): Hands-on automation using IaC tools (e.g., Terraform) to build, maintain, and scale complex cloud environments.
Hands-on experience with Python, Java, or Scala, alongside strong proficiency in SQL.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical work experience.

Ability to hit role-specific training and technical delivery milestones within the first 6 months.
Willingness to travel up to 30% as needed.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

s.h: BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO
s.t:
Shape the architecture of a fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.
Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.
Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

Shape a first-of-a-kind machine: Alpha will be the first stellarator to achieve net energy, requiring a deeply coupled design where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating all work as one system, each pushed to the edge of what it can deliver alone.
Own the coherence of the design: As part of the integrated design team, you'll turn fast-moving engineering feedback into architecture decisions that improve performance, margin, and cost.
Be accountable for the outcome: You'll be responsible for whether Alpha's concept resolves into an elegant and efficient design.

Hold the whole machine in view. Keep Alpha converging on its top-level mission requirements while detailed decisions land at a fast pace.
Close the loop between architecture and engineering. Address feedback from the subsystem teams and detailed engineering design, and fold it back into the machine architecture fast, and with judgment about what actually moves the needle.
Hunt the uncertainties that drive the design. Identify the large model uncertainties baked into our design process, quantify them, and decide where to spend margin and where to reclaim it.
Find the levers. Use first-principles estimates and reduced models to locate the changes that cut cost or unlock performance, then scope them alongside the teams who'll build them.

You've earned your judgment on complex machines. You hold a PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and you have years of experience in industries where integration challenges are at the heart of the design, such as aerospace, semiconductors, or Formula 1.
Your view goes across physics. You're as comfortable reasoning about Lorentz forces on a coil as about microwave-plasma coupling, and you know when a back-of-envelope calculation beats a week of simulation.
You reach for whatever tool fits. Being a pen-and-paper calculation, a simulator you coded last night, or a commercial multiphysics package, the method serves the question, never the reverse.
You iterate to win. You treat fast iteration as the way real machines actually get designed, learning and incorporating feedback from every loop.
You make things land. Every study, tool, and memo you produce ends in an actionable insight and a clear next step, otherwise it didn't happen.
You build in code like an engineer, not a scripter. Git, CI/CD, and the PyData stack are comfortable tools for you.

As Lead AI Architect, GTM Systems, you will set the technical vision for how Samsara's GTM technology organization builds AI-powered automation: from low-code platforms that put power in the hands of operators, to custom agentic pipelines that tackle the most complex GTM workflows.
This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide scope. You won't just advise — you'll architect, prototype, and establish the patterns that the entire GTM engineering team builds against. You'll be the person who defines when to reach for a low-code tool like Workato or Salesforce Flow, when to build a custom LangGraph agent, and how to connect them into a coherent, governed, enterprise-grade system.

You'll shape the standards, reference architectures, and evaluation frameworks that ensure Samsara's GTM systems are built to last.
This is a remote role open to candidates in Canada.

Being at the forefront of innovation is exciting, and leading transformation in a large global organization is a role that many people aspire to. We're looking for a transformational leader in our technology services hub focused on marketing technologies.
The Senior Director, Solution Architecture, is the senior technical leader accountable for the overall architecture of Coca-Cola's global MarTech, AdTech, Customer, and Commercial platforms and products.

Functioning as the chief architect for marketing technologies, this leader sets the architecture vision, standards, and patterns, and leads the community of Lead and Platform Architects across these domains, ensuring the technology landscape is coherent, scalable, secure, and built to last across all regions (North America, LATAM, EMEA, APAC).
This is a hands-on, lead-by-example role . The right leader has strong foundations in programming and architectural principles, is comfortable getting into the code with engineering teams when it helps, and works shoulder to shoulder with engineers to develop the architectural and coding patterns the organization adopts. The role sets direction through credibility and contribution, not just governance.
In Coca-Cola's networked organization, collaboration is essential . This leader earns influence by working well across teams, listening, and co-creating standards that engineers actually want to use. They are open-minded, curious, and pragmatic, balancing strong technical opinions with the humility to learn from the teams and adapt.
A defining priority of this role is to be Generative-AI savvy and forward-looking : defining how AI-native frameworks, autonomous agents, orchestration layers, vector data pipelines, and model governance operate securely and at scale across the global ecosystem, while keeping the architecture practical and cost-aware.
The Lead and Platform Architects across MarTech, AdTech, Customer, and Commercial platforms report to this leader , who is accountable for growing them and for the health of the overall architecture. This role reports to the Vice President, Platform & Product Engineering , and partners closely with the Senior Directors across Product Development, Platform, and Operations.

Architecture Vision, Standards & Governance
Serve as the chief architect for the global MarTech, AdTech, Customer, and Commercial ecosystem (owned consumer platforms, Adobe ecosystem, CDP/identity, workflow and delivery tooling, DAM/content supply chain, and key partner integrations).
Chair and govern the Architecture Review Board , establishing global engineering standards, reference blueprints, technical guardrails, and a sensible exception process that ensures consistency, security, and quality across regions.
Define and drive the long-term technology roadmap, including how legacy systems deprecate and how modern paradigms are adopted across the ecosystem.
Provide macro-level oversight to audit, optimize, and resolve major architectural dependencies across the portfolio, removing bottlenecks without micro-managing teams.
Hands-On Technical Leadership & Pattern Development
Stay hands-on : work directly with engineering teams on critical designs, prototypes, and proofs of concept, and write code alongside the team when it accelerates a decision or unblocks delivery.
Co-create the architectural and coding patterns, reference implementations, and 'paved roads' that teams adopt, so the right way is also the easy way.
Review and influence high-risk, high-impact designs (core platforms, identity, data, integrations), making clear, well-reasoned trade-offs among speed, cost, risk, and maintainability.
Lead by example on engineering craftsmanship, secure coding, and quality, raising the technical bar across the community of architects and engineers.
Lead Architect Community & Collaborative Leadership
Lead, mentor, and grow the community of Lead and Platform Architects across the four domains, aligning them around shared principles while respecting domain context.
Operate as a collaborative, networked leader : build trust across product, engineering, data, security, and regional teams, and earn adoption of standards through influence and co-creation rather than mandate.
Create the forums, office hours, and design-guidance practices that make good architecture accessible and that connect architects across the organization.
Stay open-minded and curious, bringing in outside ideas, encouraging healthy technical debate, and adapting the architecture as the landscape and the teams evolve.
Generative & Agentic AI Architecture
Define enterprise AI reference architectures (GenAI and agentic): how autonomous agents, orchestration layers, retrieval/vector pipelines, semantic caching, and model governance operate securely across Coca-Cola's global infrastructure.
Champion AI-first velocity responsibly, setting standards for LLM integration, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls, and helping teams move from AI-assisted toward AI-enabled delivery.
Establish governance for AI security: hallucination management, prompt-injection defense, and data-poisoning mitigation, embedded into the architecture by design.
Stay current with the fast-moving AI landscape and translate emerging capabilities into practical, scalable architecture decisions.
FinOps, Security & Trust by Design
Lead FinOps-aligned architecture across cloud and AI workloads, reducing compute overhead, egress, and LLM/token costs through architectural improvements, caching, and disciplined governance, while protecting performance at global scale.
Ensure privacy, data sovereignty, and Zero-Trust security are embedded by design across platforms, data flows, and partner ecosystems, satisfying global regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, LGPD) and protecting consumer trust.
Balance build vs. buy and platform-selection decisions with rigor, avoiding lock-in and unnecessary complexity.
Executive Engagement & Stakeholder Influence
Act as the primary technical liaison to senior and executive stakeholders, communicating architecture strategy, progress, risks, dependencies, and investment trade-offs with clarity and strong business framing.
Build strong relationships with agency partners and external vendors, ensuring integrations and delivery models support Coca-Cola's marketing transformation agenda.
Influence enterprise technology direction, aligning architecture with product strategy and business priorities.

Architecture & Engineering Foundations
15+ years of progressive software engineering and architecture experience, including proven success as a Principal / Lead / Chief Architect in a large-scale global ecosystem.
Strong foundations in programming and architectural principles, with the credibility and willingness to be hands-on and code with engineering teams when needed.
Deep technical depth across modern stacks (e.g., JavaScript / TypeScript, with Rust or Go familiarity), cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP), enterprise integration patterns, and large-scale platform governance.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic trains and serves frontier AI models on some of the largest and most diverse accelerator fleets in the world, and the hardware those models run on is one of the most direct levers we have on capability, cost, and reliability. Our Hardware Systems team owns the system-level architecture of that compute — from the package boundary out through boards, racks, interconnect, power, cooling, and the datacenter interface.
We're hiring senior hardware systems architects and technical leads who can work broadly across the hardware stack and go deep where it's needed, and who have the judgment to make and own directional calls — what to build, what to buy, what to co-design with a partner. You'll set architecture, write the specs that partners and internal teams build against, and own the validation and qualification strategy that proves the result.
The skillsets we need span power, cooling, mechanical, interconnect, signal integrity, data and control plane, system management, reliability and serviceability — applied across networking, compute, storage, and accelerator systems.
You'll work closely with our ML performance, infrastructure software, supply chain, and datacenter teams, and directly with hardware vendors and partners across the stack. And because this is Anthropic, you'll have Claude as a genuine collaborator — we expect this team to push on what AI-assisted hardware design and review can look like.

Own system path-finding and architecture for your domain across the breadth of compute Anthropic deploys — from concept and requirements through spec, design review, and deployment — and act as a reviewer and thought partner across the others.
Write and own high-level requirements and specifications — system, board, interface, rack — that partners and internal teams build against.
Review partner and vendor designs against our requirements, make the build / buy / co-design calls with supply chain and partnership teams, and surface misalignment or schedule risk early enough to act on it.
Drive the interconnect and networking architecture that ties our systems together — scale-up and scale-out fabrics, NICs and switches, optics, and topology.
Drive board-, chassis-, and system-level architecture with our partners — major component placement, PCB architecture, connector and cable design, and power and thermal budgeting — at the chassis, rack, and data-hall level.
Develop performance simulations, hardware models, and "what-if" scenarios to evaluate and choose between candidate hardware architectures.
Define validation, bring-up, and qualification strategy for new platforms — including the telemetry and reliability targets they need to hit in the fleet — and track the technology roadmaps and vendor landscape that shape what we deploy in the short and long term.
Partner with ML performance and infrastructure software teams so hardware decisions land well for the workloads that actually run on them.
Help shape how hardware engineering operates at Anthropic — develop and apply AI-assisted approaches to design, spec review, and validation; establish review forums, spec standards, and partner engagement.

Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one core hardware-systems domain (e.g., interconnect, power, thermal) for large-scale compute or networking systems.
Experience owning hardware system architecture at scale — machine, rack, row, and cluster — and authoring specifications and requirements.
Experience taking hardware from architecture through bring-up and high-volume production deployment.
Experience working with external hardware vendors and partners — reviewing their designs and holding them to a specification.
Ability to reason about trade-offs across adjacent hardware domains (e.g., interconnect ↔ power ↔ thermal ↔ mechanical) rather than within a single one.
Track record of technical leadership — owning directional decisions and their consequences, and driving alignment across teams and partners.
Comfort operating with high autonomy and limited process in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
Strong written communication — you'll write specs and reviews that many teams depend on.

8+ years in hardware systems architecture or engineering for hyperscale, HPC, AI/ML, or high-end networking platforms.
Experience with AI accelerator systems (GPU, TPU, or other custom ASIC platforms) and their scale-up / scale-out fabrics.
Familiarity with the chip-package-system interface and co-design.
Experience establishing a new function, program, or engineering practice.
Comfort working with — and curiosity about pushing — AI tools as part of an engineering workflow.
Degree in EE, CE, ME, CS, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Define the scale-up and scale-out interconnect architecture for a next-generation training platform, from link budget and topology through switch / NIC / optics selection and the bring-up and validation plan.

The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and it trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.
Solution Architect, APAC
Welcome to Fireblocks, the industry-leading digital asset infrastructure technology company responsible for 15% of all crypto transactions!

Fireblocks is an enterprise-grade platform for securely moving, storing, and issuing digital assets, powered by the Fireblocks Network and MPC-based wallet infrastructure. As of January 2026 we serve over 2,400 institutional customers, have secured over $10 trillion in digital asset transfers, and are the world’s highest-valued digital asset infrastructure company, with over $1 billion raised.
Our mission is simple: enable every business to easily and securely support digital assets & cryptocurrencies. Come join us as we Secure. Simplify. Scale

s.h: Here’s the bit about the opportunity
s.t: As a Solution Architect in our APAC Professional Services team, you own the technical delivery of Fireblocks implementations for the region’s largest Banks and Financial Institutions. From deal close through to production, you lead architecture design, integration, and deployment on customer infrastructure. You also bring that delivery expertise into strategic pre-sales cycles, helping Sales win the deals you will go on to deliver.

Owning the transition from deal close to production, taking end-to-end accountability for the solutions delivered
Defining enterprise customers’ setup with Fireblocks, including API integrations, security architecture, and architecture documentation
Steering complex integrations across core banking, custody, tokenisation, and Travel Rule through to production
Codifying reusable reference architectures, integration patterns, and playbooks to scale delivery across APAC
Acting as the bridge between Sales, Product, R&D, and customers to solve complex integration challenges
Supporting strategic pre-sales cycles with technical discovery and solution design
Ensuring operational excellence and a high standard of customer satisfaction throughout delivery

Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science or a related field, with 10+ years of relevant experience
Proven experience delivering post-sale implementations in complex enterprise or financial services environments
Experience with either blockchain, cryptography, or Web3 technologies, or with Banks, Financial Institutions, or enterprise financial systems. One is a must, both is a strong advantage
Software development experience and a hands-on technical mindset
Deep understanding of IT security and proven cloud experience
Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture and best practices
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring engineers or architects and setting technical standards
Pre-sales exposure (solution architecture, sales engineering, or RFP support) is a plus
Excellent written and spoken English; additional APAC languages are a plus

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued.

Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

As an Associate Solutions Architect for GitLab's SMB EMEA Sales team, you'll be a trusted advisor to GitLab prospects and customers, helping them understand how GitLab's DevSecOps platform addresses both technical requirements and business objectives across the entire software development lifecycle.

You'll guide organizations through their digital transformation journeys, from planning through monitoring, using your technical expertise, understanding of cloud and modern software development practices, and strong customer empathy.

Reporting to a regional Solutions Architect manager and partnering closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams, you'll own technical evaluations (including proof of value initiatives and workshops), shape solution architectures, and serve as the voice of the customer back to Product Management.

You'll focus on driving successful platform adoption, influencing revenue growth through solution selling, and building long-term, trust-based relationships that showcase GitLab's differentiated position in an AI-driven DevSecOps landscape.

You help drive value and change with software development for one of the fastest-growing platforms. By applying solution selling and architecture experience from planning to monitoring, you also support and enable the successful adoption of the GitLab platform by our SMB EMEA Customers. You work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Product Management, and Marketing organizations to realize customer value. Key milestones include:
In the first 30 days, successful completion of the Solutions Architect Onboarding plan.
Within two months, collaborate closely with your peers to gain comprehensive knowledge of the GitLab platform, DevOps practices, and associated technologies and learn through shadowing our value selling approach.
Within three months you start to engage with customers, both onsite and remote, in a technical consultancy and advisor role during the pre-sales process while providing technical assistance and solution guidance.
In partnership with the sales team, you formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue targets through the adoption of GitLab.
With comprehensive knowledge of the GitLab platform and associated technologies, you educate SMB customers on the value proposition of GitLab while participating in discussions throughout the organization to ensure successful GitLab deployment.
You guide technical evaluations via POC/POV ownership, RFP/audit support, and workshop design.
You build relationships with people within customer environments to enable them to be GitLab advocates.
Serve as the customer advocate to other GitLab teams, including Product Development, Sales, and Marketing.
Continuously improve your professional skills with a focus on personal mastery and team learning through activities such as training, reading, and seeking mentorship from others.
Maintain specialty competency in one or more technologies related to GitLab's market focus through activities such as training, certification, and creation of working examples for reuse internally and by customers and partners

1-2+ years of experience engaging with customers in pre-sales, consulting, or similar roles, guiding them through solution design and evaluation.
Experience or an eagerness to understand the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows.
Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, with the ability to discuss deployment, security, and operations options with technical teams.
Ability to lead technical evaluations such as proofs of concept or proofs of value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messages for practitioners through to senior business and technical decision makers.
Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, and acting as a customer advocate to internal teams such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
Motivation to continuously develop professionally, including learning new technologies, deepening GitLab platform expertise, and applying transferable experience from related fields
German OR French language fluency - desirable

We, the Solutions Architect team, are part of GitLab's Sales organization and serve as the technical counterpart to Account Executives, with this role focused on opportunities across our SMB EMEA Sales Segmentation and reporting into a regional Solutions Architect Manager.

Our mission is to help customers realize the full value of GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform by advising on architecture, running technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guiding customers through their digital transformation.

We work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing, collaborating asynchronously across regions to share best practices, create reusable technical collateral, and act as the voice of the customer.

We are focused on helping customers modernize end-to-end software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a rapidly evolving AI and DevSecOps landscape.

Our GTM Systems team sits at the center of Klaviyo's GTM engine, powering the operational infrastructure that connects marketing, sales, partnerships, and customer success. We build and own the systems that enable our teams to move quickly, trust their data, and focus on what matters most: helping our customers grow.
Our GTM Systems Partner team is a small group of technical builders owning the Salesforce platform and its integrations across our full GTM stack from lead routing and lifecycle management to the external-facing partner portal and its integrations with partner management and payment systems data.

As the Senior GTM Partner Systems Architect, you are the domain expert for our partnerships business systems. You own the Salesforce-to-partner-portal ecosystem, including all integrations with partner management and payment data.

You translate ambiguous business problems into system architecture (diagrams, data models, design docs), drive the roadmap by looking around the corner with the Product Owner, and stay hands-on to build and ship meaningful parts of the solution yourself, not just diagram it from a distance.
Klaviyo's operational infrastructure, built and managed by our GTM Systems team, powers our GTM engine. We’re looking for a Senior GTM Partner Systems Architect - a domain expert who can architect how our partnerships business systems work, and who is hands-on enough to build, ship, and de-risk the hardest parts.
How you'll make an impact
Own end-to-end architecture for our partnerships business systems — turning ambiguous business asks into documented designs (architecture diagrams, data models, sequence flows) that the wider GTM Systems team can build against.
Stay hands-on: build proof-of-concepts and ship Apex, LWC, Flow, and complex integrations yourself. Track your work in GitHub to ensure it remains a reusable asset for the wider team.
Set and uphold engineering standards through architecture reviews, GitHub-based pull request reviews, and pairing that other developers build against.
Lead story and backlog refinement with the Product Owner, surfacing technical constraints and tradeoffs early, and looking around the corner to shape the roadmap before problems become urgent.
Serve as the go-to domain expert for Sales Ops, Marketing Ops, RevOps, and senior leadership. You will translate complex architectural decisions into language that resonates with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Mentor developers on system design, code quality, and tradeoff thinking, building the muscle for others to make good architectural calls without you in the room.

Klaviyo is seeking an AI Solutions Architect to accelerate how our Customer Success organization leverages AI to operate smarter and deliver more impact.
This role sits at the intersection of applied AI, solutions architecture, and internal enablement. We're looking for a strong technical problem solver who can quickly turn business challenges into practical AI solutions while collaborating across technical and non-technical teams.
You'll build AI-powered solutions that solve both creative and operational challenges. Your work will span accelerating content creation, enabling smarter learning experiences, connecting internal data sources, and automating workflows that improve efficiency and decision-making.
You'll also help teams use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Glean more effectively by building skills, prompts, and AI workflows that are reliable, reusable, and aligned to real business needs. As solutions grow in complexity, you'll help facilitate the evolution of workflows and prototypes into production-grade systems, working closely with Klaviyo's centralized AI engineering team and leveraging their support to scale larger, cross-functional initiatives.
This role sits within the Strategy & Operations team and serves as connective tissue across the broader Success organization, helping identify high-impact opportunities, accelerate experimentation, and scale successful AI solutions across the business.

Program Strategy & Discovery
Partner with Success leaders to identify high impact areas that could benefit from AI or automation
Prioritize opportunities based on efficiency gains and impact
Translate ambiguous ideas into clear program roadmaps with defined outcomes and milestones
Technical Prototyping & Productization
Build AI-powered prototypes and workflows using Claude, LLMs, and modern AI development platforms to rapidly validate business solutions.
Design and connect AI systems using APIs, MCPs, automation platforms, and internal data sources to create intelligent, end-to-end workflows.
Understand how to integrate AI solutions with existing systems, collaborating with engineering teams when production-grade implementations are needed.
Develop effective prompts, skills, agents, and retrieval workflows that improve the quality, reliability, and usefulness of AI-generated outputs.
Evaluate and iterate on AI solutions using user feedback, business outcomes, and emerging best practices to drive adoption and impact.
Enablement & AI Literacy
Create clear documentation, implementation guides, and best practices that enable teams to effectively build and adopt AI solutions.
Lead enablement sessions, workshops, and office hours to grow AI fluency and help teams build effective prompts, skills, agents, and workflows.
Stay current on emerging AI capabilities, tools, and best practices

A systems thinker with a strong technical foundation and a passion for solving business problems with AI.
Experienced building AI-powered prototypes using LLMs and modern AI tools, with an understanding of APIs and system integrations.
A strong communicator who can translate technical concepts, create clear documentation, and enable others to adopt AI effectively.
Comfortable partnering with engineering teams to scale successful solutions into production when needed.

4+ years of experience in AI solutions, solutions architecture, internal tooling, automation, or similar technical roles.
Hands-on experience building solutions with Claude or other leading LLM platforms, including prompt engineering, skills, agents, and AI workflows.
Experience integrating AI with APIs, internal systems, or data sources to solve business problems and improve team workflows.
Demonstrated ability to rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on AI-powered solutions based on user feedback and business needs.

As Salesforce Architect, you will be the technical backbone of Marqeta's Business Systems team, a lean, high-impact group that serves as the internal Salesforce platform team for Go-To-Market (GTM), Product Support, and Legal, Risk & Compliance (LRC). This is a heavily hands-on lead individual contributor role, you will be writing code, configuring the platform, and directly solving hard technical and business problems, not just producing designs for others to build.
We are looking for someone who has genuinely operated as an architect, owning architecture decisions, tradeoffs, and their consequences for at least 2 years, not an engineer aspiring to grow into the title.

You will set the architectural direction for our Salesforce platform, conduct code reviews, lead architecture and design sessions, build and maintain the technical backlog, proactively identify gaps in systems and processes, and independently drive solutions to completion.

You will also be a hands-on builder: configuring, coding, and deploying complex solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and our ongoing migration from CPQ to Revenue Cloud.

You will drive our Agentforce and AI strategy, own integrations with critical systems like Ironclad, Intacct, and the broader GTM toolchain, and play a lead role in ongoing security hardening of the Salesforce org.
Your work will directly support strategic company-wide initiatives, improve customer experience, and increase productivity for internal users across GTM, support, and compliance functions.
We work Flexible First . This role can be performed remotely in the United States, only in one of our National locations, which you can review here .
The Impact You'll Have
Architecture & Design
Own end-to-end Salesforce architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Revenue Cloud (including our active CPQ → Revenue Cloud migration)
Lead architecture and design sessions, producing clear design documents, solution options, and tradeoff analyses
Author and maintain coding and design standards for SFDC and ecosystem applications.
Conduct thorough code reviews and enforce engineering best practices, security standards, and declarative-first design principles
Build and maintain the technical backlog—translating platform observations, stakeholder needs, and audit findings into well-scoped engineering work
Proactively identify gaps in system design, data integrity, automation, and integrations; propose and deliver solutions before they become incidents
Conduct regular Org Health Assessments and define a continuous improvement roadmap for platform quality, security, and performance

About MongoDB
MongoDB는 변화를 위해 만들어졌습니다. 우리는 고객과 구성원들이 시장의 속도에 맞춰 혁신할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 우리는 AI 시대를 위한 데이터 플랫폼을 새롭게 정의함으로써, 빌더들이 소프트웨어를 통해 산업을 창조하고, 변화시키며, 혁신할 수 있도록 돕고 있습니다. 시장에서 가장 폭넓게 제공되며 전 세계에 분산된 MongoDB의 통합 데이터 플랫폼은 조직이 레거시 워크로드를 현대화하고, 혁신을 수용하며, AI의 잠재력을 최대한 발휘할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 클라우드 네이티브 플랫폼인 MongoDB Atlas는 전 세계에 분산된 유일한 멀티클라우드 데이터 플랫폼으로, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure 전반에서 사용할 수 있습니다.
전 세계에 오피스를 두고 있는 MongoDB는 67,000개 이상의 고객을 보유하고 있으며, 여기에는 포춘 100대 기업의 75%와 AI 네이티브 스타트업이 포함됩니다. 이들은 가장 중요한 애플리케이션을 MongoDB로 운영하고 있으며, 우리는 소프트웨어의 다음 시대를 이끌고 있습니다.
MongoDB에서 우리의 나침반은 Leadership Commitment 입니다. 이는 우리가 어떻게, 그리고 왜 의사결정을 내리는지, 서로를 위해 어떻게 행동하는지, 그리고 어떻게 함께 성공하는지를 이끄는 기준입니다. 이것이 바로 MongoDB를 MongoDB답게 만드는 요소입니다.
우리는 모든 구성원의 개인적 성장과 비즈니스 영향력을 높이기 위해, 모든 사람에게 지지와 풍요로움을 제공하는 문화를 만드는 데 헌신하고 있습니다. 직원 커뮤니티(affinity groups)에서부터 난임 치료 지원, 그리고 넉넉한 부모 휴가 제도 에 이르기까지, 우리는 구성원의 웰빙을 중요하게 여기며, 그들의 직업적·개인적 여정을 모든 단계에서 지원합니다. MongoDB에서 일하는 것이 어떤 경험인지 더 알아보고, 세상에 변화를 만드는 우리의 여정에 함께해 주세요!

Promote responsible, enterprise-ready AI adoption aligned to governance and trust standards.

As an **early-in-career Partner Solution Architect (PSA)**, you will work closely with Microsoft partners to design, validate, and scale innovative cloud and AI solutions that help customers achieve their business goals.

You will collaborate with technical and business stakeholders, provide architectural guidance, and help partners accelerate adoption of Microsoft technologies.

This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deep technical and partner engagement skills, and build expertise across Microsoft's cloud, AI, and security solutions.

Microsoft offers a flexible work environment, allowing employees to work from home part of the time while collaborating regularly with their teams and partners.
As a **Partner Solution Architect**, you will gather partner insights and leverage these insights to design solution architectures, provide technical expertise, develop and validate Microsoft solutions, and help partners achieve business outcomes through successful technology adoption.

You will act as a trusted technical advisor, supporting solution design, readiness, and the adoption of new Microsoft technologies. This opportunity will allow you to leverage your knowledge of Microsoft products, services, and value propositions in partner conversations while identifying opportunities to drive partner growth and customer success.
Microsoft-s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* You will act as the voice of the customer (VOC)/partner by learning to identify and share feedback around technical capabilities, blockers and insights that relate to the customer/partner with internal teams.
* You will demonstrate basic technical concepts and prove those design solutions' capability through design collaboration sessions with the customer/partner and support customer skilling needs by participating in discussions on technical delivery with other internal and external stakeholders to transfer knowledge and contribute to customer readiness.
* With supervision, you will identify issues and advises customers/partners to operate and optimize performance in accordance with Microsoft best practices and apply methodology and governance, as directed, to minimize business and technical risks and adhere to quality assurance while ensuring excellence in contributions to design and/or delivery of solutions.

* You will learn to identify and communicate areas in intellectual property (IP) that need refreshing or have gaps and contribute to IP development with guidance/supervision.

As a Senior Solutions Architect based in Singapore (reporting to the Asia Solutions Architect Manager), you'll join GitLab's Asia team as the trusted advisor to prospects, customers and partners across the region, helping them understand how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform addresses both technical requirements and business objectives across the entire software development lifecycle.

You'll drive successful platform adoption, influence revenue growth through solution and value selling, and build long-term, trust-based relationships that showcase GitLab's differentiated position in an AI-driven DevSecOps landscape.

Lead technical discovery, demos, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the full lifecycle.
Drive the technical evaluation process as the directly responsible individual, including solution design, proof of concept or proof of value ownership, workshop design, and the technical components of tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
Collaborate with Account Executives and the broader go-to-market team across Asia to shape and execute account strategies that support new customer acquisition and expansion.
Build and deepen relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guiding them through GitLab-driven transformation and enabling them to become GitLab advocates.
Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration, continuous deployment, security, and cloud practices, challenging existing approaches to improve return on investment.
Serve as the voice of the customer with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing by sharing feedback, use cases, and competitive insights that inform roadmap and positioning.
Maintain and expand your technical expertise in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and related cloud technologies by creating reusable examples, best-practice guidance, and technical collateral for customers and partners.
Invest in your growth and development through ongoing learning, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to improve the Solutions Architect team's impact continuously.

Experience engaging with customers in technical pre-sales, consulting, or similar roles, guiding them through solution design and evaluation.
Proficiency with the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices, continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows, and the application of Generative and Agentic AI within software delivery.
Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, continuous integration and continuous deployment, and collaboration platforms, and the ability to map platform capabilities to customer use cases.
Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, with the ability to discuss deployment, security, and operations options with technical teams.
Ability to lead technical evaluations such as proofs of concept or proofs of value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messages for practitioners through to senior business and technical decision makers.
Fluent Mandarin language skills are required for this role, with the ability to engage stakeholders from C-level executives through to end-user buyers confidently. This role covers markets where Mandarin is essential to effective customer engagement, primarily Singapore and Taiwan.
Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, and acting as a customer advocate to internal teams such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
Motivation to continuously develop professionally, including learning new technologies, deepening GitLab platform expertise, and applying transferable experience from related fields.

We work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing, collaborating asynchronously across regions to share best practices, create reusable technical collateral, and act as the voice of the customer.

Shopware ist ein führendes E‑Commerce‑System, das Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open‑Source‑Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändler und Hersteller in B2C und B2B eingesetzt.
Die Position ist im Bereich IT Operations im Team IT Infrastructure angesiedelt, das die interne IT‑Infrastruktur der shopware AG verantwortet. Als IT Infrastructure Architect – Cloud Focus (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Vision und Architektur der internen Infrastruktur von Shopware .

Du planst und steuerst die Cloud‑Migration verbleibender On‑Prem‑Umgebungen, definierst die Netzwerk‑ und Sicherheitsarchitektur und prägst Standards, Governance und Budgetierung. Mit Gestaltungsspielraum für Konzeption, Umsetzung und Iteration hilfst du, eine zukunftsfähige interne Plattform aufzubauen – vom Fundament bis zum Betrieb.
Diese Position kann vor Ort , hybrid oder vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands besetzt werden. Dein Arbeitsort wird im Voraus abgestimmt und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags.
Du übernimmst die End‑to‑End‑Verantwortung für unsere Infrastruktur‑Vision und Roadmap, wie die Komponenten heute zusammenspielen und wie sie sich weiterentwickeln sollen.
Durch die Migration von On‑Premise‑Umgebungen in die Cloud (AWS) modernisierst du unsere interne Infrastruktur und reduzierst Risiken für interne Services. Dabei definierst du Patterns und Leitplanken , die andere wiederverwenden können.
Du entwirfst und entwickelst unsere Netzwerkinfrastruktur weiter und stellst Segmentierung, Resilienz und Betriebsfähigkeit sicher.
Du überprüfst und erhöhst den Standard bei Monitoring, Backup/Restore und Observability (z. B. PRTG, Datadog, AWS CloudWatch), um Zuverlässigkeit und Wiederherstellbarkeit zu garantieren.
Gemeinsam mit unserem IT Security Specialist und dem Information Security Officer übersetzt du Sicherheitsanforderungen in praxisnahe Kontrollen – von Firewall‑Policies bis zu Identity & Access (Azure AD/ID, lokales AD).
Du planst und steuerst das Infrastruktur‑Budget , optimierst Cloudkosten und triffst fundierte Make‑or‑Buy‑Entscheidungen.
Hands‑on bleibt Teil der Rolle: Du unterstützt Migrationen, arbeitest eng mit Cloud Engineers zusammen und hilfst bei der Lösung komplexer Incidents, bei denen architektonischer Kontext entscheidend ist.
Du leitest Projekte und führst bei Bedarf kleine Projektteams fachlich, um Meilensteine termingerecht und qualitätsgesichert zu liefern.
Du arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern (Team Lead IT Administration, gesamtes IT‑Infrastructure‑Team) sowie bereichsübergreifenden Partnern innerhalb von Shopware (z. B. Information Security Officer, Product) zusammen, stimmst Pläne ab und sequenzierst Veränderungen sicher.

Du verfügst über 2–3 Jahre in einer vergleichbaren Architektur‑/Leitungsrolle über Cloud‑ und On‑Prem‑Infrastrukturen.
Dein breites technisches Fachwissen erlaubt es dir, Netzwerk, Identity, Compute, Storage, Backup/DR und Security zusammenzudenken und pragmatische, skalierbare Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Cloud‑Kompetenz – insbesondere AWS – sowie vCenter, Azure AD/ID und lokales AD befähigen dich, Migrationen und hybride Setups souverän zu steuern.
Du bewegst dich sicher in IaC , Enterprise‑Networking , VPN und Monitoring‑Stacks ; wir setzen Terraform, SonicWall, Cisco Meraki, Tailscale sowie PRTG/Datadog/CloudWatch ein – Erfahrung mit vergleichbaren Tools ist ebenso wertvoll.
Ausgeprägte Planungs‑ und Stakeholder‑Management‑Skills helfen dir, Roadmaps zu koordinieren, Engpässe früh zu antizipieren und Verbindlichkeit sowie termingerechte Umsetzung sicherzustellen.
Security ist ein integraler Bestandteil deiner Arbeit: Du übersetzt Richtlinien in durchsetzbare, prüfbare Kontrolle n über den gesamten Stack.
Kommunikation zählt zu deinen Stärken: Du erklärst komplexe Trade‑offs klar , passt deine Botschaften vom Executive‑Briefing bis zur technischen Spezifikation an und richtest Teams hinter einem Plan aus.
Sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist erforderlich; Deutsch ist ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning
At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.
This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.
Senior AI Architect
o9 is restructuring its technology organization around purpose-built engineering groups, upgrading to modern tech stacks and AI-first software to drive a streamlined, R&D-focused powerhouse. As part of this transformation, we are building a world-class core AI function from the ground up to serve as the foundational intelligence layer across all product engineering domains.
This is a premier technical individual contributor (IC) role with the structural weight, seniority, and impact of an SVP. We are looking for someone who has lived on the bleeding edge of artificial intelligence at industry-defining technology companies—someone who can take a bold architectural vision and turn it into production reality.
The Scale of Opportunity
o9 is on a trajectory that very few enterprise software companies ever reach. We are building toward a global footprint of 10,000 enterprise customers—each running complex, mission-critical supply chain and business planning operations on our platform. At that scale, AI is not a buzzword or a feature add-on; it is our core strategic differentiator.
Our ambition goes further: o9 is pursuing a neurosymbolic AI architecture—combining the reasoning power of large language models with the formal rigor of symbolic computation and constraint-based planning. The platform that emerges will be unlike anything currently available in enterprise software. The person who steps into this role will literally write the playbook and construct the foundation for this architecture.
To understand the core philosophy behind what you will be building, review the framework established by our EVP of AI, Ashwin Rao:
Read the fundamental thesis onThe Neurosymbolic Imperative for Enterprise AI.
Explore the practical application of this paradigm inDavos Insights: Turning VUCA into Value with Neuro-Symbolic AI.
The north star for our customers is the APEX operating model—a state of integrated, autonomous, AI-driven planning that eliminates the friction between insight and action across the enterprise. This role is the architectural engine that makes APEX possible.
What you’ll own
You are single-handedly accountable for o9’s core AI architectural integrity and our neurosymbolic roadmap. Your mandate covers the following pillars:
Neurosymbolic Platform Architecture: Architect the hybrid systems that seamlessly blend LLMs with deterministic, constraint-based planning engines, translating high-level conceptual vision into concrete, scalable code and system designs.
AI Strategy & Governance: Set the technical standard for how AI is implemented across the entire engineering organization, ensuring framework consistency, performance optimization, and enterprise-grade reliability.
Cutting-Edge R&D Evaluation: Continually evaluate, benchmark, and integrate state-of-the-art models, agentic workflows, and vector infrastructures into the core o9 platform.
Technical Truth: Serve as the ultimate technical court of appeal for complex AI engineering roadblocks, deep triage, and algorithmic limitations.
What you’ll build
The foundational architecture for o9’s neurosymbolic AI engine, successfully bridging the gap between connectionist (neural networks) and symbolic AI.
The framework and blueprints that allow hundreds of product engineers to safely, predictably, and continuously ship AI-driven capabilities.
The next-generation intelligence layer enabling 10,000 enterprise customers to run autonomous business planning at an order of magnitude more scale than we serve today.
What you’ll have
Experience: 15+ years of deep engineering background, with a distinguished track record of building and transforming advanced software platforms.
Tier-1 Tech Background: Significant engineering tenure at a premier technology organization (e.g., FAANG, Uber, Slack, Snowflake, Stripe, Datadog, or comparable).
Proven AI Leadership: Clear track record as a principal or lead architect on production-grade AI/ML systems at massive scale.
Neurosymbolic Aptitude: Deep, hands-on familiarity with both large language models (generative AI, embeddings, vector databases) and traditional, structured, constraint-based symbolic computation.
High Autonomy: Direct, fast, and exceptionally comfortable operating without bureaucratic approval chains. You move quickly, own your architectural decisions, and hold yourself accountable for outcomes.
